Aisha Khan: Heads up — just finished 1:1 with Acme onboarding lead. Renewal ~45d. They dropped a few product asks and one blocker on per-route cost visibility. Quick list below.
Marco Li: please paste the notes? curious about blocker.
Aisha Khan: sure — raw:
- need per-route token breakdown in console
- want "preview" mode for embeddings to test similarity before commit
- request: quicker model rollbacks in Dedicated (canary took 6h)
- blocker: onboarding SLA docs don't show cost at sample workloads (blocked finance signoff)
Priya Patel: thanks. any usage numbers? are they heavy on chat or embeddings?
Aisha Khan: mostly embeddings (search/recall). sample: 2M tokens/month projected, 200k embedding vectors first 3mo
Sara Nguyen: @Aisha can you file a quick ticket in product tracker and tag `prio:high`? I'll take embeddings UX + per-route cost.
Aisha Khan: filed: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-5832 — description + transcript snippet. pinged @Sara earlier.
Marco Li: re rollback: sounds infra/runtime — assigning to eng-runtime for triage. @Ethan Rivera FYI
Ethan Rivera: saw this. can we add a rollback window metric to rollout dashboard? I'll spin up a small spike.
Priya Patel: prioritization ask: CS wants per-route cost > embeddings preview > rollback window. Is that our shared order?
Sara Nguyen: agree. embedding preview can be a quick UX prototype (2 wks). Per-route cost needs backend data join (4-6 wks). Rollback metric = infra spike (1-2 wks).
Aisha Khan: perfect. action items:
1) @Sara create EPIC linking CS-5832 + tickets for each workstream
2) @Ethan add rollout dashboard spike
3) CS will prep a short ROI note for Acme finance (Aisha)
Sara Nguyen: will do. looping in @Marco for perf constraints.
Aisha Khan: also flagged renewal risk: they'll pause if finance signoff doesn't land in 3w. putting this on runway.
Priya Patel: noted. CS will escalate in weekly AM. :warning:
OnboardBot: Reminder: Renewal check-in scheduled in 14 days for Acme (owner: Aisha Khan)
Aisha Khan: thanks — will follow up. closing thread here unless more questions.
